text:
Maya: Hey team — final draft of the product launch post is in Google (shortlink: https://go.redwood/draft-launch). Can folks do a focused pass today? Main asks: 1) benchmarks accuracy, 2) hero CTA phrasing, 3) webinar registration routing, and 4) any legal/claims flags. TL;DRs in the top of the doc. :rocket:

Jordan: On it — will double-check the benchmark numbers vs the latest infra report. Quick Q: are we keeping the 99ms p99 number in the hero or moving to 120ms since some regions saw higher tail? @Maya

Maya: Good call. Keep 99ms for the headline only if we add the footnote about region-dependent p99s. If not, switch to "sub-100ms" phrasing. I prefer the footnote so the PR/analyst folks have the exactness.

Sana: Skimming now. Two quick items: 1) the claim "costs 3x less" needs the specific workload and comparison called out, 2) remove the customer name from the example quote unless we have approval. I'll add inline comments.

Liam: I pushed a suggested CTA variant in the doc: "See pricing & performance" vs "Try the hosted API". For webinar routing — if someone registers from the blog CTA we should tag them as "launch_webinar" and route to the webinar nurture flow. Who can confirm webhook path? @Priya

Priya: I can wire the tag. We'll send to the existing webinar flow but want to run a small test: blog -> conversion webhook -> CRM -> send nurture + manual demo opt-in. Please confirm the form fields we require (email, company, role).

Maya: Confirmed: email, company, role. Add a hidden field campaign=launch_march. Also let's include a utm_source=blog_launch. Liam, Jordan — are we ok with the CTA CTA text if we use the pricing/perf link?

Jordan: Yes, pricing & performance is better for conversion for technical buyers. :+1: We'll also set up a secondary CTA for non-technical to "Join product webinar" in the hero subline.

Sana: Posted inline redlines around the benchmark table. Also flagged the sentence about "enterprise-ready SLAs" — need to avoid promising specific SLAs unless we list the tiers.

ContentBot: Lint check complete — 12 passive voice suggestions, 3 long sentences > 210 chars, recommended shortening the hero paragraph.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Can we aim to lock copy by 5pm PT? Jordan will finalize the numbers, Sana will clear legal flags, Liam + Priya will confirm webhook fields, and I'll submit final to design for the hero asset. If anything blocks the lock, ping me directly. :calendar:

Liam: I'll validate the webhook and send the test payload by 3pm PT.

Jordan: Benchmark update in doc now (row: synthetic vs production -- clarified). Changed hero to "sub-100ms p99 (region dependent)" per Maya.

Sana: Legal sign-off pending one customer permission — emailing now. If we don't get permission, we swap the quote to anonymized.

Priya: Webhook and form mapped. Test payload sent to #integrations with log snippet.

Maya: Awesome — last ask: small screenshot for the benchmark chart for the blog hero (high-res) — can design grab that tonight once I lock copy? :eyes:

ContentBot: Accessibility check: color contrast on chart labels fails WCAG for small text — recommend increasing label size or adjusting hue.

Maya: Noted — design, please bump label size. Locking time still 5pm PT unless we hit legal hold. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
